title: NVIDIA GPU worker
description: Turn an NVIDIA GPU host into mesh capabilities: GPU inventory, a bounded CUDA matmul smoke probe, a whitelisted short-task executor and detached background jobs. Scripts are restricted to an operator-supplied allowlist of absolute paths; arbitrary shell strings are never executed. Every GPU use is pinned with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, guarded by a per-device advisory lock and a free-VRAM preflight.

python.description: Python interpreter used by every executor and by allowlisted user scripts. Point it at a venv that has torch to enable gpu.smoke; otherwise gpu.smoke returns ok:false JSON.

jobDir.description: Writable directory for job workspaces, logs, locks and results. Put it on a data disk, not on a small root filesystem.

deviceAllowlist.description: Comma-separated GPU indices this pack may use. The default 0,2 avoids the two cards typically left free on a four-GPU shared host; review nvidia-smi before changing it.

scriptAllowlist.description: Absolute paths of operator-approved scripts that gpu.exec and gpu.job.submit may run. Empty disables script execution. fedcap renders this value into FEDCAP_GPU_SCRIPT_ALLOWLIST as comma-separated or JSON-array text; the executors accept both.

capabilities.title: NVIDIA GPU inventory
capabilities.description: List the host's NVIDIA GPUs with UUID, memory, utilization, temperature, driver version and running compute processes, plus the configured device allowlist and per-GPU allowed flags. Read-only.

capabilities.title: GPU compute smoke test
capabilities.description: Run one bounded cuBLAS square matmul on the allowlisted GPU with the most free VRAM and report device, free VRAM, latency and GFLOPS. Picks 4096x4096 float32 by default, never loads a model, and returns ok:false JSON when torch is unavailable in the configured python.

device.description: Optional GPU index from the device allowlist; defaults to the allowlisted GPU with the most free VRAM.

capabilities.title: Run one whitelisted GPU action
capabilities.description: Run exactly one whitelisted action: a fixed nvidia-smi query (read-only) or an allowlisted python script. The script receives args.params as JSON on stdin, runs with the configured python and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pinned, holds a per-device advisory lock and is refused when free VRAM is below minFreeMiB. Arbitrary shell strings, inline code and URLs are not accepted; captured output is capped at 64 KiB.

action.description: nvidia_smi_query is read-only; python_script runs one allowlisted script.

query.description: Fixed nvidia-smi query set; only used by the nvidia_smi_query action.

script.description: Absolute path of an allowlisted script; required by the python_script action.

params.description: JSON object passed to the script on stdin (python_script action only).

args.description: Alias for params; the same JSON object is passed to the script on stdin.

device.description: Optional GPU index from the device allowlist (python_script action only).

timeoutSec.description: Hard execution timeout for the action.

minFreeMiB.description: Minimum free VRAM required before the script starts.

capabilities.title: Submit a background GPU job
capabilities.description: Start one allowlisted python script as a detached background job under jobDir and return a jobId immediately. The script receives args.params on stdin, runs with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pinned, holds the per-device advisory lock for its whole lifetime and is killed as a process group when timeoutSec expires. Resubmitting the same operationKey returns the original job instead of starting a duplicate.

action.description: Only allowlisted python scripts can be submitted as jobs.

script.description: Absolute path of an allowlisted script.

params.description: JSON object passed to the script on stdin.

args.description: Alias for params; the same JSON object is passed to the script on stdin.

device.description: Optional GPU index from the device allowlist.

timeoutSec.description: Hard job timeout; the job process group is terminated when it expires.

minFreeMiB.description: Minimum free VRAM required before submission.

operationKey.description: Optional idempotency key; reuse it to recover the jobId after a lost response.

capabilities.title: Poll a background GPU job
capabilities.description: Return the state (queued, running, succeeded, failed, timeout or lost), exit code, device, script and timing metadata of one background job. Read-only.

capabilities.title: Read background job output
capabilities.description: Return the current status plus the tail of a background job's captured stdout and stderr. tailBytes bounds each stream; both are capped so one response stays below 64 KiB, with truncated flags when older bytes were dropped.

checks.description: executors import cleanly against the shared helper
checks.command: {{python}} -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '{{packDir}}/bin'); import _common, _job_runner, gpu_info, gpu_smoke, gpu_exec, gpu_job_submit, gpu_job_status, gpu_job_result; print('ok')"
